name: Window opaque inspection surrogate

original_specification.name: Window opaque inspection surrogate
original_specification.purpose: An opaque port/window stand-in for geometric inspection without a transmission claim.

baseline_projection.value_basis: Original, unmeasured preview choices; no grade-specific optical constants.
baseline_projection.fidelity: Uniform opaque response only; detailed target behavior is not encoded.

advanced_target.optical_model: Finite-thickness optical window with optional anisotropic, spectral or polarization-aware response when required.

authoring_controls.meaning: Fixed opaque stand-in; does not represent window transmittance.

geometry_and_mapping_requirements: Model both faces and the window edge
Keep mounting and optical surfaces independently assignable
Require crystal orientation only if the advanced model uses it
unknown_optical_inputs: Optical constants for the specified window material
validation_criteria: The opaque preview must not suggest that internal contents are visible
Polarization or birefringence requires explicit transport support, not an ordinary RGB tint

scope: Exact original opaque baseline; advanced source intent remains explicit.
